children: Enterprise Products Partners L.P. reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $17.95 billion, up 49.3% from the prior-year quarter, while net income attributable to common unitholders rose 21.4% to $1.62 billion and diluted EPS increased 23% to $0.75. Revenue growth primarily reflected higher marketing revenues.
Revenue was $17.95B, compared with $12.02B in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 49.3%.
Net income attributable to common unitholders was $1.62B, compared with $1.34B; YoY change 21.4%.
Diluted EPS was $0.75, compared with $0.61; YoY change 23%.
Gross operating margin increased in NGL, natural gas and petrochemical services, while crude oil segment margin edged down.
NGL pipeline, marine terminal and fractionation volumes rose, as did natural gas pipeline transportation volumes.
Neches River export capacity entered service in May 2026. The Athena processing train and EHT export expansion are scheduled for late 2026.
Planned growth projects include four additional Permian processing trains and 150-MBPD Frac 15, with service dates spanning 2027 to 2029.
